categories.main_business_segments: NOMURA Co., Ltd. (Nomura Kogeisha) operates primarily in the display business, providing end-to-end solutions for the creation of customer-attracting environments. This includes research and consulting, planning and design, architectural design, production and construction, as well as facility and event activation and management. The company serves various markets such as specialty stores, department stores, shopping centers, corporate PR facilities, museums, leisure facilities, expositions/events, and other spaces like offices and bridal venues.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced planning, design, and production technologies, including Building Information Modeling (BIM) for productivity and quality improvement, and sustainable design and construction methods. It emphasizes integrated project management from concept through operation, and invests in R&D for new spatial presentation techniques, digital media, and environmentally conscious solutions. Quality and safety are managed through ISO9001 and ISO14001 certified systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nomura's key customers are businesses and organizations requiring high-impact physical spaces, such as retailers (specialty and department stores), shopping malls, hospitality and leisure operators (hotels, theme parks, entertainment venues), museums, public institutions, and corporations seeking PR and promotional environments. The company also serves event organizers and local governments for exhibitions and public spaces.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a nationwide presence in Japan, with regional offices covering Hokkaido, Tohoku, Chugoku-Shikoku, Kyushu, and Okinawa, in addition to major metropolitan areas. Internationally, it operates subsidiaries in China (Beijing), Singapore, and Malaysia, focusing on expanding its footprint in the Asian market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nomura operates as a downstream integrator and service provider, acting as a prime contractor for spatial design and construction projects. It manages the entire value chain from consulting and design to construction and facility management, often subcontracting production and installation work to specialized partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company aims to enhance its core business sophistication, expand into new business domains, and deliver social value through sustainability. R&D focuses on innovative spatial design, digital and experiential technologies, BIM adoption, and sustainable materials and methods. The company also prioritizes talent development, digital transformation (DX), and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based contracts for design, construction, and management of commercial and public spaces. This includes consulting fees, design and construction contracts, facility operation, and event management services. Some recurring revenue is derived from maintenance, facility management, and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese display and spatial design firms such as Tanseisha and Space, as well as construction and event production companies. Nomura positions itself as a market leader with comprehensive capabilities, a long history, and a strong reputation for quality and innovation in the display and spatial creation industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending February 2025, consolidated sales reached 150.3 billion yen, with operating profit of 8.9 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 6.8 billion yen. The company has shown strong growth, with sales increasing 12% and net profit up 75% year-on-year, reflecting a robust recovery and expansion in core markets. The group employs over 2,000 people.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nomura emphasizes its ability to deliver 'spaces that attract and inspire,' combining creative planning, design, and technical execution. Its differentiation lies in its integrated, end-to-end project capabilities, deep expertise across diverse facility types, commitment to sustainability, and a track record of delivering high-profile, complex projects. The company also highlights its focus on social value, innovation, and customer-centric solutions.
